item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Mindset. Your schedule has real weight today, but built into it are several honest check-ins: whether this moment fits the life you're building, whether you're projecting instead of asking, whether old patterns are sneaking back in. Those pauses matter more than the tasks around them. Don't rush past them for busywork. Action: before your next thing starts, take one breath and actually answer the question in front of you.
